value.rationale: The source has a real nonuniform population-extinction problem: fixed mixing changes repeated squaring into geometric decay, so fixed-parameter limits cannot predict the transient time. The finding locates the singular double-logarithmic generation and determines an exact initial-data-scaled crossover coefficient despite the coupled two-step multiplier. Its motivation is the dynamics of an explicit published stochastic mixture, not an arbitrary numerical slice, while related five-phase results limit generic novelty.
